name: study1-quality-criteria
title: Study 1 Dataset Quality Criteria
description: Fitness-for-use quality criteria for datasets created using the Study 1 feature set (medication prescription in patients hospitalised for acute heart failure with chronic kidney disease or hyperkalaemia). Criteria follow the harmonised Kahn framework: completeness criteria in the verification context and plausibility criteria in the validation context.

criteria.name: lvefCompleteness
criteria.description: Percentage of records with a recorded LVEF value (most recent before discharge). LVEF is needed to distinguish HFrEF from HFpEF when assessing guideline-directed medication.
criteria.expression: SELECT count(*) AS num_valid FROM dataset WHERE echocardiographs_lvef_lvef IS NOT NULL

criteria.name: potassiumCompleteness
criteria.description: Percentage of records with at least one potassium measurement during the hospital stay. Potassium defines the hyperkalaemia subgroup of the study.
criteria.expression: SELECT count(*) AS num_valid FROM dataset WHERE lab_results_potassium_value_last IS NOT NULL

criteria.name: systolicBloodPressureCompleteness
criteria.description: Percentage of records with at least one systolic blood pressure measurement during the hospital stay.
criteria.expression: SELECT count(*) AS num_valid FROM dataset WHERE vital_signs_systolicBp_value_last IS NOT NULL

criteria.name: natriureticPeptideCompleteness
criteria.description: Percentage of records with at least one natriuretic peptide measurement (NT-proBNP or BNP) during the hospital stay.
criteria.expression: SELECT count(*) AS num_valid FROM dataset WHERE lab_results_ntProBnp_value_last IS NOT NULL OR lab_results_bnp_value_last IS NOT NULL

criteria.name: inHospitalDiureticCapture
criteria.description: Percentage of records with a diuretic prescribed or administered during the hospital stay. Diuretics are given to the large majority of patients hospitalised for acute heart failure, so a low value indicates that in-hospital medication is not captured in the source data.
criteria.expression: SELECT count(*) AS num_with_diuretic FROM dataset WHERE med_requests_diuretics_any = true OR med_admins_diuretics_any = true

criteria.name: nyhaCardinality
criteria.description: Having all 4 NYHA classes represented in the dataset (nyha_nyha)
criteria.expression: SELECT count(DISTINCT nyha_nyha) AS nyha_count FROM dataset WHERE nyha_nyha IS NOT NULL

criteria.name: smokingStatusCardinality
criteria.description: Having both smokers and non-smokers in the dataset (smoking_status_smoker_last). A single value indicates that smoking status is not captured in the source data.
criteria.expression: SELECT count(DISTINCT smoking_status_smoker_last) AS smoking_status_count FROM dataset WHERE smoking_status_smoker_last IS NOT NULL

criteria.name: serumCreatininePlausibleMedian
criteria.description: Median serum creatinine of the cohort, expected in mg/L. A median outside 6-20 mg/L indicates a unit mismatch in the source mapping (e.g. values delivered in mg/dL), which also invalidates the calculated eGFR and the CKD staging.
criteria.expression: SELECT percentile_approx(lab_results_validSerumCreatinine_value_pET, 0.5) AS median_creatinine FROM dataset WHERE lab_results_validSerumCreatinine_value_pET IS NOT NULL

criteria.name: potassiumPhysiologicallyImpossible
criteria.description: Number of records whose last potassium value during the stay is below 1 or above 12 mmol/L. Such values are not compatible with life and indicate placeholder or mis-entered results.
criteria.expression: SELECT count(*) AS num_impossible FROM dataset WHERE lab_results_potassium_value_last < 1 OR lab_results_potassium_value_last > 12

criteria.name: lvefOutOfRange
criteria.description: Number of records with an LVEF value below 0% or above 100%.
criteria.expression: SELECT count(*) AS num_out_of_range FROM dataset WHERE echocardiographs_lvef_lvef < 0 OR echocardiographs_lvef_lvef > 100

criteria.name: plausibleSexDistribution
criteria.description: Percentage of male patients, expected between 40% and 70% for a cohort hospitalised for heart failure.
criteria.expression: SELECT count(*) AS num_males FROM dataset WHERE patient_demographics_gender = 'male'

criteria.name: lengthOfStayPlausible
criteria.description: Number of records with a hospital stay longer than 365 days. Such stays indicate encounters whose end date is missing or wrongly mapped.
criteria.expression: SELECT count(*) AS num_implausible FROM dataset WHERE encounters_lengthOfStay > 365
